methods.source:
dataDir
^ '/data'

ensureDir: aPath
LibC system: 'mkdir -p ', aPath asString, ' >/dev/null'

pathFor: aString
^ self dataDir, '/', aString

readJson: fileName default: defaultValue
| ref |
	ref := (self pathFor: fileName) asFileReference.
	ref exists ifFalse: [ ^ defaultValue ].
	^ [ STONJSON fromString: ref contents ]
		on: Error do: [ :e | defaultValue ]

writeJson: fileName value: anObject
| final tmp |
	self ensureDir: self dataDir.
	final := (self pathFor: fileName) asFileReference.
	tmp := (self pathFor: fileName, '.tmp') asFileReference.
	tmp writeStreamDo: [ :s | s nextPutAll: (STONJSON toString: anObject) ].
	final exists ifTrue: [ final ensureDelete ].
	tmp moveTo: final

marker
^ (self readJson: 'marker.json'
		default: (Dictionary new at: 'n' put: 0; yourself))
		at: 'n' ifAbsent: [ 0 ]

writeMarker: n
self writeJson: 'marker.json'
		value: (Dictionary new at: 'n' put: n asInteger; yourself)

journal
^ (self readJson: 'journal.json' default: #()) asArray

journalAppend: sourceString
| j |
	j := self journal asOrderedCollection.
	j add: sourceString asString.
	self writeJson: 'journal.json' value: j asArray

replayUpTo: n
| failures j limit |
	failures := OrderedCollection new.
	j := self journal.
	limit := n min: j size.
	1 to: limit do: [ :i | | r |
		r := self evalQuiet: (j at: i).
		((r beginsWith: 'ERROR:') or: [ r beginsWith: 'EXCEPTION:' ])
			ifTrue: [ failures add: (i -> r) ] ].
	^ failures

isDefinition: sourceString
| s |
	s := sourceString asString.
	^(s includesSubstring: 'subclass:')
		or: [ (s includesSubstring: 'compile:')
		or: [ (s includesSubstring: 'removeSelector:')
		or: [ (s includesSubstring: 'instanceVariableNames:') ] ] ]

eval: sourceString
| source before result clean |
	source := sourceString asString.
	before := Smalltalk globals keys asSet.
	result := self evalQuiet: source onError: [ :error |
        (self isDefinition: source) ifFalse: [
            LLMRepairService current ifNotNil: [ :service |
                [ service capture: error source: source ] on: Error do: [ :captureError |
                    Transcript show: 'LK-INCIDENT-ERROR: ', captureError asString; cr; flush ] ] ] ].
	((source beginsWith: '// nojournal') not
		and: [ self isDefinition: source ]) ifTrue: [
		clean := ((result beginsWith: 'ERROR:')
			or: [ (result beginsWith: 'EXCEPTION:')
			or: [ (result beginsWith: 'NOTIFICATION:') ] ]) not.
		clean ifTrue: [
			self journalAppend: source.
			(Smalltalk globals keys asSet difference: before) do: [ :sym |
				(sym asString endsWith: 'Tests')
					ifTrue: [ self addTestClassNamed: sym asString ] ] ] ].
	^ result

evalQuiet: sourceString
^ self evalQuiet: sourceString onError: [ :error | ]

evalQuiet: sourceString onError: handler
| result wrapped |
    wrapped := '[' , sourceString asString , '] value'.
    result := [ Smalltalk compiler evaluate: wrapped ]
        on: Error do: [ :error | handler value: error. ^ 'ERROR: ', error asString ].
    ^ result isNil ifTrue: [ 'nil' ] ifFalse: [
        [ result printString ] on: Error do: [ :error | 'a ', result class name asString ] ]

truncate: aString to: n
| s |
	s := aString asString.
	^ s size <= n ifTrue: [ s ] ifFalse: [ s copyFrom: 1 to: n ]

boot
| failures |
	failures := self replayUpTo: self marker.
	Transcript show: ('LK-BOOT: replayed ', self marker asString, ' entries, ',
		failures size asString, ' failures'); cr; flush.
	^ 'boot ok'

shadowRun: spec
| n candidatePath reproPath outPath report tests reproResult candResult |
	n := spec at: 'n' ifAbsent: [ 0 ].
	candidatePath := spec at: 'candidate'.
	reproPath := spec at: 'repro' ifAbsent: [ nil ].
	outPath := spec at: 'out'.
	self replayUpTo: n.
	candResult := self evalQuiet: candidatePath asFileReference contents.
	reproResult := 'skipped'.
	reproPath ifNotNil: [ :p |
		(p asFileReference exists
			and: [ p asFileReference contents ~= 'nil' ])
				ifTrue: [ reproResult := self evalQuiet: p asFileReference contents ] ].
	tests := TestRunner runAll.
	report := Dictionary new
		at: 'tests' put: tests;
		at: 'repro' put: (self truncate: reproResult to: 500);
		yourself.
	report at: 'candidate' put: (self truncate: candResult to: 300).
	report at: 'ok' put: ((tests at: 'ok')
		and: [ (self reproPassed: reproResult)
		and: [ (self evalResultFailed: candResult) not ] ]).
	(outPath asFileReference) parent ensureCreateDirectory.
	outPath asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s |
		s nextPutAll: (STONJSON toString: report) ].
	^ report

evalResultFailed: aString
| r |
	r := aString asString.
	^ (r beginsWith: 'ERROR:')
		or: [ (r beginsWith: 'EXCEPTION:')
		or: [ (r beginsWith: 'NOTIFICATION:') ] ]

reproPassed: aString
| r |
	r := aString asString.
	(r = 'skipped' or: [ r = 'none' or: [ r = 'nil' ] ])
		ifTrue: [ ^ true ].
	(r beginsWith: 'EXCEPTION:') ifTrue: [ ^ false ].
	(r beginsWith: 'ERROR:') ifTrue: [ ^ false ].
	^ (r = 'false') not

config
^ self readJson: 'config.json' default: Dictionary new

configAt: key put: value
| c |
	c := self config.
	c at: key asString put: value.
	self writeJson: 'config.json' value: c.
	^ c

configAt: key default: defaultValue
^ self config at: key asString ifAbsent: [ defaultValue ]

healed
^ (self readJson: 'healed.json' default: #()) asArray

noteHealed: entry
| h |
	h := self healed asOrderedCollection.
	h add: entry.
	self writeJson: 'healed.json' value: h asArray

addTestClassNamed: aString
| names |
	names := self testClassNames asOrderedCollection.
	(names includes: aString asString) ifFalse: [
		names add: aString asString.
		self writeJson: 'tests.json' value: names asArray ]

testClassNames
^ (self readJson: 'tests.json'
		default: #('VendingMachineTests')) asArray

rollbackTo: n
| safe |
	safe := n asInteger min: self journal size max: 0.
	self writeMarker: safe.
	^ (Dictionary new at: 'ok' put: true; at: 'marker' put: safe; yourself)

runAll
| passed failed descriptions |
	passed := 0. failed := 0. descriptions := OrderedCollection new.
	LiveKernel testClassNames do: [ :className | | cls |
		cls := Smalltalk globals at: className asSymbol ifAbsent: [ nil ].
		cls ifNotNil: [
			(cls selectors select: [ :s | s asString beginsWith: 'test' ])
				do: [ :selector | | outcome |
					outcome := [ cls new perform: selector. nil ]
						on: Error do: [ :e | e ].
					outcome isNil
						ifTrue: [ passed := passed + 1 ]
						ifFalse: [
							failed := failed + 1.
							descriptions add: (LiveKernel truncate:
								(className, '>>', selector asString, ': ', outcome asString)
								to: 400) ] ] ] ].
	^ Dictionary new
		at: 'run' put: passed + failed;
		at: 'passed' put: passed;
		at: 'failed' put: failed;
		at: 'ok' put: failed = 0;
		at: 'failures' put: descriptions asArray;
		yourself

queueDir
^ LiveKernel dataDir, '/queue'

ensureQueue
LiveKernel ensureDir: self queueDir

loop
| running |
    LLMRepairService start.
	self ensureQueue.
	Transcript show: ('LK-READY: queue at ', self queueDir); cr; flush.
	running := true.
	[ running ] whileTrue: [
		| dir |
		dir := self queueDir asFileReference.
		(dir entries select: [ :e | (e basename asString endsWith: '.in')
				and: [ e isFile ] ])
			asArray
			do: [ :e | | name content reply outName |
				name := e basename asString.
				content := [ (dir / name) contents ]
					on: Error do: [ :x | '{}' ].
				reply := [ self handleJob: content ]
					on: Error do: [ :er | 'JOB-ERROR: ', er asString ].
				outName := name copyFrom: 1 to: name size - 3.
				(dir / (outName, '.out'))
					writeStreamDo: [ :s | s nextPutAll: reply asString ].
				[ (dir / name) ensureDelete ] on: Error do: [ :x | ].
				(reply = 'SHUTDOWN') ifTrue: [ running := false ] ].
        [ LLMRepairService current poll ] on: Error do: [ :error |
            Transcript show: 'LK-REPAIR-ERROR: ', error asString; cr; flush ].
		[ (dir / 'heartbeat.txt')
			writeStreamDo: [ :s | s nextPutAll: Time millisecondClockValue printString ] ]
			on: Error do: [ :x | ].
		(Delay forMilliseconds: 100) wait ].
	Transcript show: 'LK-BYE'; cr; flush.
	Smalltalk snapshot: false andQuit: true

handleJob: jsonText
| job kind |
	job := [ STONJSON fromString: jsonText ] on: Error do: [ :e | nil ].
	job ifNil: [ ^ LiveKernel truncate: 'ERROR: bad job JSON' to: 800 ].
	kind := job at: 'type' ifAbsent: [ 'eval' ].
	kind = 'eval' ifTrue: [
		^ LiveKernel eval: (job at: 'code' ifAbsent: [ 'nil' ]) ].
	kind = 'tests' ifTrue: [ ^ STONJSON toString: TestRunner runAll ].
	kind = 'status' ifTrue: [ ^ STONJSON toString: LiveKernel status ].
	kind = 'promote' ifTrue: [ ^ STONJSON toString: LiveKernel promote ].
	kind = 'rollback' ifTrue: [
		^ STONJSON toString: (LiveKernel rollbackTo:
			(job at: 'marker' ifAbsent: [ 0 ])) ].
	kind = 'test_candidate' ifTrue: [
		^ STONJSON toString: (Supervisor
			testCandidate: (job at: 'code' ifAbsent: [ 'nil' ])
			repro: (job at: 'repro' ifAbsent: [ nil ])) ].
	kind = 'config' ifTrue: [
		(job at: 'llmUrl' ifAbsent: [ nil ]) ifNotNil: [ :u |
			LiveKernel configAt: 'llmUrl' put: u ].
		(job at: 'llmModel' ifAbsent: [ nil ]) ifNotNil: [ :md |
			LiveKernel configAt: 'llmModel' put: md ].
        (job at: 'automaticRepair' ifAbsent: [ nil ]) ifNotNil: [ :enabled |
            LiveKernel configAt: 'automaticRepair' put: enabled ].
		(job at: 'agentMode' ifAbsent: [ nil ]) ifNotNil: [ :md |
			LiveKernel configAt: 'agentMode' put: md asString ].
		^ STONJSON toString: LiveKernel status ].
	kind = 'heal' ifTrue: [ ^ STONJSON toString: (AgentBridge handleHeal: job) ].
	kind = 'incidents' ifTrue: [ ^ STONJSON toString: LLMRepairService current incidents ].
	kind = 'healed' ifTrue: [ ^ STONJSON toString: LiveKernel healed ].
	kind = 'shutdown' ifTrue: [ ^ 'SHUTDOWN' ].
	^ LiveKernel truncate: 'ERROR: unknown job type: ', kind asString to: 800

healDir
^ LiveKernel dataDir, '/heal'

ensureHealDir
LiveKernel ensureDir: self healDir

nextId
| ref n |
	self ensureHealDir.
	ref := (self healDir, '/.seq') asFileReference.
	n := ref exists
		ifTrue: [ [ ref contents asInteger ] on: Error do: [ :e | 0 ] ]
		ifFalse: [ 0 ].
	n := n + 1.
	ref writeStreamDo: [ :s | s nextPutAll: n asString ].
	^ n

startCandidate: candidateSource repro: reproSource
| candFile reproFile outFile driver |
    candFile := self writeTemp: 'auto-cand' contents: candidateSource extension: 'st'.
    reproFile := self writeTemp: 'auto-repro' contents: reproSource extension: 'st'.
    outFile := self writeTemp: 'auto-out' contents: 'PENDING' extension: 'txt'.
    driver := self writeTemp: 'auto-driver'
        contents: (self driverForCandidate: candFile repro: reproFile out: outFile) extension: 'st'.
    LibC system: 'DRIVER=', driver fullName printString,
        ' sh /opt/pharo/scripts/shadow_run.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &'.
    ^ outFile fullName

workspaceDir
^ LiveKernel dataDir, '/workspace'

writeTemp: prefix contents: aString extension: ext
| ref |
	LiveKernel ensureDir: self workspaceDir.
	ref := (self workspaceDir, '/', prefix, '-',
		Time millisecondClockValue printString, '-',
		(aString asString hash abs \\ 99991) printString, '.', ext)
			asFileReference.
	ref writeStreamDo: [ :s | s nextPutAll: aString asString ].
	^ ref

testCandidate: candidateSource repro: reproSource
| candFile reproFile outFile driver rc outer |
	candFile := self writeTemp: 'cand' contents: candidateSource extension: 'st'.
	reproFile := self writeTemp: 'repro'
		contents: (reproSource ifNil: [ 'nil' ]) extension: 'st'.
	outFile := self writeTemp: 'out' contents: 'PENDING' extension: 'txt'.
	driver := self writeTemp: 'driver'
		contents: (self driverForCandidate: candFile repro: reproFile out: outFile)
		extension: 'st'.
	rc := LibC system: 'DRIVER=', driver fullName printString,
		' sh /opt/pharo/scripts/shadow_run.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; exit $?'.
	outer := [ STONJSON fromString: outFile contents ]
		on: Error do: [ :e | nil ].
	outer isNil ifTrue: [
		^ Dictionary new
			at: 'ok' put: false;
			at: 'rc' put: rc;
			at: 'detail' put: 'shadow output missing or malformed';
			yourself ].
	^ Dictionary new
		at: 'ok' put: (outer at: 'ok' ifAbsent: [ false ]);
		at: 'rc' put: rc;
		at: 'detail' put: outer;
		yourself

driverForCandidate: candidatePath repro: reproPath out: outPath
| d q installText |
	q := (Character value: 39) asString.
	installText := '/opt/pharo/kernel/install_eval.st' asFileReference contents.
	d := WriteStream on: String new.
	d nextPutAll: installText.
	d nextPutAll: '.'.
	d nextPutAll: String cr.
	d nextPutAll: '(Smalltalk globals at: #LiveKernel) shadowRun: (Dictionary new'.
	d nextPutAll: ' at: ', q , 'n', q , ' put: ', LiveKernel journal size printString, ';'.
	d nextPutAll: ' at: ', q , 'candidate', q , ' put: ', q ,
		candidatePath fullName, q , ';'.
	d nextPutAll: ' at: ', q , 'repro', q , ' put: ', q ,
		reproPath fullName, q , ';'.
	d nextPutAll: ' at: ', q , 'out', q , ' put: ', q ,
		outPath fullName, q , ';'.
	d nextPutAll: ' yourself).'.
	d nextPutAll: String cr , 'Smalltalk snapshot: false andQuit: true.'.
	^ d contents

init
price := 50.
	paid := 0

price: anAmount
price := anAmount

insertCoin: anAmount
paid := paid + anAmount

dispense
paid >= price ifFalse: [ self error: 'insufficient credit' ].
	paid := paid - price.
	^ 'product'

make
^ self new init

repairContract
^ 'A vending machine starts with price 50 and paid 0. insertCoin: adds credit. dispense must raise insufficient credit when paid < price; otherwise it subtracts price from paid and returns product. Repair behavior without changing the public protocol or instance variable layout.'

repairExpectedErrors
^ #('insufficient credit')

verify: aBoolean description: desc
aBoolean ifFalse: [ self error: desc ]

testDispenseAfterCredit
| vm |
	vm := VendingMachine make.
	3 timesRepeat: [ vm insertCoin: 20 ].
	self verify: vm dispense = 'product' description: 'should dispense'

testInsufficientCreditRaises
| vm raised |
	vm := VendingMachine make.
	raised := false.
	[ vm dispense ] on: Error do: [ :e | raised := true ].
	self verify: raised description: 'should raise on empty credit'

current
^ Smalltalk globals at: #LKRepairService ifAbsent: [ nil ]

start
Smalltalk globals at: #LKRepairService put: self new initialize

initialize
pending := Dictionary new.
 history := (LiveKernel readJson: 'incidents.json' default: #()) asOrderedCollection.
 history do: [ :incident |
   (#('awaiting-model' 'verifying') includes: (incident at: 'status')) ifTrue: [
     incident at: 'status' put: 'cancelled-on-restart' ] ].
 self save.
 ^ self

save
LiveKernel writeJson: 'incidents.json' value: history asArray

incidents
^ history asArray

literal: value
(value isNil or: [ value == true or: [ value == false ] ]) ifTrue: [ ^ value printString ].
 (value isNumber or: [ value isString or: [ value isSymbol ] ]) ifTrue: [
   value printString size <= 1000 ifTrue: [ ^ value printString ] ].
 ^ nil

capture: error source: operation
| context frames allowed target receiver selector method fingerprint state arguments repro request incident id sourceText contract tests |
 (LiveKernel configAt: 'automaticRepair' default: false) = true ifFalse: [ ^ nil ].
 pending size >= 8 ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
 allowed := LiveKernel configAt: 'repairClasses' default: #('VendingMachine').
 context := error signalerContext.
 frames := OrderedCollection new.
 target := nil.
 1 to: 40 do: [ :index |
   context ifNotNil: [
     frames add: (LiveKernel truncate: context methodClass name asString, '>>', context selector asString to: 200).
     target isNil ifTrue: [
       ((allowed includes: context receiver class name asString)
         and: [ allowed includes: context methodClass name asString ]) ifTrue: [ target := context ] ].
     context := context sender ] ].
 target ifNil: [ ^ nil ].
 receiver := target receiver.
 (receiver class respondsTo: #repairContract) ifFalse: [ ^ nil ].
 (receiver class respondsTo: #repairExpectedErrors) ifTrue: [
   (receiver class repairExpectedErrors includes: error messageText) ifTrue: [ ^ nil ] ].
 selector := target selector.
 method := target method.
 fingerprint := receiver class name asString, '>>', selector asString, ':', method sourceCode hash asString, ':', error class name asString, ':', error messageText.
 (history anySatisfy: [ :entry | (entry at: 'fingerprint') = fingerprint ]) ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
 state := Dictionary new.
 repro := WriteStream on: String new.
 repro nextPutAll: '| receiver | receiver := (Smalltalk globals at: #', receiver class name asString, ') basicNew.'.
 receiver class allInstVarNames withIndexDo: [ :name :index | | literal |
   literal := self literal: (receiver instVarAt: index).
   literal ifNil: [ ^ nil ].
   state at: name put: literal.
   repro nextPutAll: ' receiver instVarAt: ', index asString, ' put: ', literal, '.' ].
 arguments := target arguments collect: [ :value | self literal: value ].
 (arguments anySatisfy: [ :value | value isNil ]) ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
 repro nextPutAll: ' receiver perform: #', selector asString, ' withArguments: {'.
 arguments withIndexDo: [ :literal :index |
   index > 1 ifTrue: [ repro nextPutAll: '. ' ]. repro nextPutAll: literal ].
 repro nextPutAll: '}. true'.
 sourceText := WriteStream on: String new.
 receiver class selectors sorted do: [ :sel |
   sourceText nextPutAll: (receiver class >> sel) sourceCode; cr; cr ].
 receiver class class selectors sorted do: [ :sel |
   sourceText nextPutAll: receiver class name asString, ' class>>'; nextPutAll: (receiver class class >> sel) sourceCode; cr; cr ].
 tests := WriteStream on: String new.
 LiveKernel testClassNames do: [ :name | | testClass |
   testClass := Smalltalk globals at: name asSymbol ifAbsent: [ nil ].
   testClass ifNotNil: [ testClass selectors sorted do: [ :sel |
     tests nextPutAll: name, '>>'; nextPutAll: (testClass >> sel) sourceCode; cr; cr ] ] ].
 contract := receiver class repairContract.
 id := AgentBridge nextId.
 request := Dictionary new
   at: 'id' put: id; at: 'kind' put: 'incident';
   at: 'problem' put: error class name asString, ': ', error messageText;
   at: 'target' put: receiver class name asString;
   at: 'selector' put: selector asString;
   at: 'repro' put: repro contents;
   at: 'operation' put: (LiveKernel truncate: operation to: 2000);
   at: 'stack' put: frames asArray; at: 'state' put: state;
   at: 'classSource' put: (LiveKernel truncate: sourceText contents to: 16000);
   at: 'testsSource' put: (LiveKernel truncate: tests contents to: 12000);
   at: 'contract' put: contract;
   at: 'journalSize' put: LiveKernel journal size; yourself.
 incident := Dictionary new
   at: 'id' put: id; at: 'target' put: (request at: 'target');
   at: 'selector' put: selector asString; at: 'problem' put: (request at: 'problem');
   at: 'fingerprint' put: fingerprint; at: 'status' put: 'awaiting-model';
   at: 'journalSize' put: LiveKernel journal size;
   at: 'started' put: Time millisecondClockValue;
   at: 'request' put: request; yourself.
 history add: incident. pending at: id put: incident. self save.
 LiveKernel writeJson: 'heal/req-', id asString, '.json' value: request.
 ^ id

finish: incident status: status detail: detail
incident at: 'status' put: status; at: 'detail' put: detail.
 incident removeKey: 'request' ifAbsent: [ ].
 incident removeKey: 'started' ifAbsent: [ ].
 pending removeKey: (incident at: 'id') ifAbsent: [ ].
 self save

allowedSource: source for: incident
| ast statements node method |
 ast := RBParser parseExpression: source.
 statements := ast isSequence ifTrue: [ ast statements ] ifFalse: [ { ast } ].
 statements size = 1 ifFalse: [ ^ false ].
 node := statements first.
 (node isMessage and: [ node selector = #compile: ]) ifFalse: [ ^ false ].
 (node receiver isVariable and: [ node receiver name asString = (incident at: 'target') ]) ifFalse: [ ^ false ].
 (node arguments size = 1 and: [ node arguments first isLiteralNode ]) ifFalse: [ ^ false ].
 node arguments first value isString ifFalse: [ ^ false ].
 method := RBParser parseMethod: node arguments first value.
 ^ method selector asString = (incident at: 'selector')

poll
pending values asArray do: [ :incident |
   [ self advance: incident ] on: Error do: [ :error |
     self finish: incident status: 'repair-error' detail: error asString ] ]

advance: incident
| response file request source decision verdict result |
 (LiveKernel configAt: 'automaticRepair' default: false) = true ifFalse: [
   ^ self finish: incident status: 'cancelled' detail: 'automatic repair disabled' ].
 LiveKernel journal size = (incident at: 'journalSize') ifFalse: [
   ^ self finish: incident status: 'stale' detail: 'code changed during investigation' ].
 request := incident at: 'request'.
 (incident at: 'status') = 'awaiting-model' ifTrue: [
   (Time millisecondClockValue - (incident at: 'started')) > 300000 ifTrue: [
     ^ self finish: incident status: 'supervisor-timeout' detail: 'no decision within 300 seconds' ].
   file := (AgentBridge healDir, '/resp-', (incident at: 'id') asString, '.json') asFileReference.
   file exists ifFalse: [ ^ nil ].
   response := STONJSON fromString: file contents.
   (response at: 'id' ifAbsent: [ nil ]) = (incident at: 'id') ifFalse: [
     ^ self finish: incident status: 'bad-supervisor-response' detail: 'response id mismatch' ].
   decision := response at: 'decision' ifAbsent: [ 'invalid' ].
   (#('expected' 'insufficient-evidence') includes: decision) ifTrue: [
     ^ self finish: incident status: decision detail: (response at: 'reason' ifAbsent: [ '' ]) ].
   source := response at: 'source' ifAbsent: [ nil ].
   (decision = 'repair' and: [ source isString and: [ source isEmpty not ] ]) ifFalse: [
     ^ self finish: incident status: 'bad-supervisor-response' detail: (response at: 'error' ifAbsent: [ 'invalid repair decision' ]) ].
   (self allowedSource: source for: incident) ifFalse: [
     ^ self finish: incident status: 'out-of-scope' detail: 'automatic repairs must compile only the failing application method' ].
   incident at: 'source' put: source;
     at: 'reason' put: (response at: 'reason' ifAbsent: [ '' ]);
     at: 'outPath' put: (Supervisor startCandidate: source repro: (request at: 'repro'));
     at: 'status' put: 'verifying'; at: 'started' put: Time millisecondClockValue.
   self save. ^ nil ].
 file := (incident at: 'outPath') asFileReference.
 (Time millisecondClockValue - (incident at: 'started')) > 150000 ifTrue: [
   ^ self finish: incident status: 'shadow-timeout' detail: 'shadow did not finish' ].
 file exists ifFalse: [ ^ nil ].
 verdict := [ STONJSON fromString: file contents ] on: Error do: [ :error | nil ].
 verdict ifNil: [ ^ nil ].
 (verdict at: 'ok' ifAbsent: [ false ]) = true ifFalse: [
   ^ self finish: incident status: 'shadow-verify-failed' detail: verdict ].
 result := LiveKernel eval: (incident at: 'source').
 (LiveKernel evalResultFailed: result) ifTrue: [
   ^ self finish: incident status: 'swap-failed' detail: result ].
 LiveKernel noteHealed: (Dictionary new at: 'id' put: (incident at: 'id');
   at: 'target' put: (incident at: 'target'); at: 'source' put: (incident at: 'source');
   at: 'swapResult' put: result; at: 'automatic' put: true; yourself).
 self finish: incident status: 'repaired' detail: verdict
